# FAQ-013 Engineering FAQ #13

Revision: Rev A

Q1: What lubricant part number should be used for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02)?
A1: Use CFW-LUB-497 as the lubricant part number for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02). See maintenance reference MM-P2-L3-HT02 for lubrication intervals and SOP-P3-L3-05 for application procedure.

Q2: What is the austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03)?
A2: The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 870 °C. Confirm with SB-1045 for process validation records and SOP-P3-L3-05 for furnace cycle verification steps.

Q3: What is the maximum ring outer diameter permitted in Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02)?
A3: The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm. Refer to SB-1045 for tooling limits and MM-P2-L3-HT02 for handling and storage constraints.

Q4: What torque is specified for the main ram bolt on Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03)?
A4: The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Apply using calibrated tooling per SOP-P3-L3-05 and log torque application in maintenance records MM-P2-L3-HT02.

Q5: What is the austenitizing setpoint for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02)?
A5: The austenitizing setpoint for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) is 845 °C. Validate setpoint against SB-1045 and follow verification steps in SOP-P3-L3-05 before production runs.

Related documents: MM-P2-L3-HT02, SB-1045, SOP-P3-L3-05.
